title: @InjectSpy causes smallrye unable to find config
body:
### Describe the bug

I upgraded from `3.21.1` to `3.24.0.CR1` and I get the following config error when I run the `SpyTest` test from the [reproducer](https://github.com/gbourant/quarkus-test-profile-bug)

```
[ERROR] Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 1, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 0.370 s <<< FAILURE! -- in gr.SpyTest

Caused by: java.util.NoSuchElementException: SRCFG00027: Could not find a mapping for gr.ProjectConfig

	at io.quarkus.arc.generator.Default_jakarta_enterprise_context_ApplicationScoped_ContextInstances.computeIfAbsent(Unknown Source)

```


```java
@QuarkusTest
public class SpyTest {

    @InjectSpy
    ProjectConfig projectConfig;

    @Test
    public void shouldRun() {
    }
}
```

Is also seems that if you add a simple test which does not use the `@InjectSpy` both tests will pass.

```java
@QuarkusTest
public class NoSpyTest {

    @Inject // it does not use InjectSpy
    ProjectConfig projectConfig;

    @Test
    public void shouldRun() {
    }
}
``
